issue.title: Retire coder_inherits_planner_chat
issue.description: Opt-in beta: the follow-up coder inherits the planner's chat via #fork instead of starting from the approved plan file alone.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Forked coders have landed several epics with no plan-fidelity regression against the plan-file-only path, and the `#fork` context cost is acceptable at typical planner chat lengths.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The follow-up coder starts from the approved plan file alone, with no planner chat context.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: The follow-up coder launched after plan approval inherits the planner's chat through `#fork`, so it starts with the planner's full reasoning context in addition to the approved plan file reference.

payload.entry:
PROVENANCE: this bead replaces sase-nw, the `flag`-issue-type bead that owned `coder_inherits_planner_chat` from its creation at 2026-08-16T23:31:52Z by bbugyi200.athena.sase-nb.9 until epic sase-pv phase sase-pv.7 (migrate) deleted it on 2026-08-18. Feature flags are no longer their own bead type, so the old bead could not be converted in place -- the bead store's append-only guard makes `issue_type` immutable after `issue_created` -- and it was removed with `sase bead rm` and re-created here through `create_flag_bead`, the path `sase flag new` uses.

CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED: title, size (medium), kind (beta), and both removal thresholds (2026-11-14 / 0.18.0). No deadline moved as a side effect of the migration.

AUTHORED FOR THE NEW REQUIRED FIELDS: `when_enabled`, `when_disabled`, and `remove_when` were drafted in the epic plan and each was verified against the code before it was written here. `src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py` now points `coder_inherits_planner_chat` at sase-qe.

TRIAL MATRIX (sase-ru.4 / 2026-08-21): recommend ABANDON beta; keep unconditional plan-file-only. Evidence artifact file:explicit:0b50eb32321cc48fb8e48e7b. Production never enabled On (0/676 followup_prompt.md contain #fork). Planner chats are synthetic 10-line stubs for 811/820 pairs (format_plan_as_response); #fork does not inject planner reasoning (that is live_reply.md only). Matched sase xprompt expand '#fork:<planner>': small/medium incremental ~1.6-1.9KiB (~400-480 tok) of user prompt+stub+truncated plan already inlined by @plan; noisy feedback planners 04l.f1=58704B (~15k tok, 5.1x plan) and 001.f1=168938B (~42k tok, 18.7x plan) dump prior family/coder turns that can contradict the new approved plan. Off coders completed in all sampled pairs including 001.f1. Strict --code pairs: 0 failed/0 killed. 10% .fN rework is user-driven replans, not missing planner-only facts. Do not promote On; do not keep a config field. sase-ru.9: make Off unconditional, remove the flag, close this bead canceled/abandoned citing the artifact — not a successful removal that would make On unconditional.

Abandoned coder_inherits_planner_chat. Trial matrix file:explicit:0b50eb32321cc48fb8e48e7b (sase-ru.4) showed no material fidelity benefit: 0/676 production followup_prompt.md used #fork; typical On add-on is ~400-480 tokens of stub duplication; noisy planners inject 15k-42k tokens of prior-family context (001.f1 fork=168938B, 18.7x plan) while Off still completed. Made Off unconditional in run_agent_exec_plan_accept (fresh coder context + @plan, no #fork). Removed FeatureFlag.coder_inherits_planner_chat, registry/schema/help/docs, and On-state tests. Verified: tools/check_feature_flags --static; .venv/bin/sase flag list has no coder_inherits_planner_chat (unknown env key warned and ignored); 85 focused tests passed.

payload.close_reason: Abandoned the coder_inherits_planner_chat beta after the sase-ru.4 trial. Keep unconditional plan-file-only coder handoff; this is not a successful flag removal that would make the authored On/#fork path unconditional.
